content.short: We offer a diverse collection of 5,555 hand-crafted NFTs brought to life through our unique story-based narrative.
content.description:
The four elements comprising the metaverse have been summoned for a special mission….help decide the fate of Fengu!

We are inspired by the anime designs of Japan and wanted to create a fun, cute, chibi style. Our cell-shaded graphics have been hand-crafted by our in-house artist, Shumu, to help to bring our story to life. At Fengu, we have a deep passion for launching community-centric initiatives. Everything from the development of the story to the design decisions is decided by the early adopters, those who have been a part of our DAO since the beginning. We hope you’ll join us and be part of the ongoing development and evolution of Fengu Innovation and rich storytelling is at the heart of what we do here at Fengu.

Our team has crafted a rich story to capture the imagination of the community and bring about new and exciting features to the NFT space. Fengu story Nestled deep in the foothills of Fengu, The Valley of Wind stands as one of the most beautiful places in the Metaverse.

Blessed by the hand of God himself, jagged mountains and lush green forests spring up from the land. But despite the beauty and awe, this valley is one of the most dangerous places on Earth. Something has tainted this land. The wind has become destructive, carrying with it chaos and imbalance. Whispers of turmoil echo across the land, and the wind has turned on the people, bringing with it a path of destruction, reducing entire cities to rubble. In order to protect the valley from this plague, the people call upon the Shaman, master of the four elements. The shaman has summoned four heroes to restore balance: Air, water, fire, and earth. Together, they must save the valley from imminent destruction.

The only question remaining….can they do it alone? As the wind becomes increasingly aggressive, the Yandzi River is showing signs of weakness.

The time for heroes is upon us.
